title: WAN Load Balancing
subtitle: Multi-WAN traffic distribution and failover across uplinks

globals.title: WAN Global Settings
globals.description: Configure global options that apply to all WAN load balancing rules.
globals.disableSourceNatHelp: Disable MASQUERADE on outbound interfaces (use when upstream already handles NAT).
globals.enableLocalTrafficHelp: Apply load balancing to locally-generated traffic from the router itself.
globals.flushConnectionsHelp: Reset existing connections when a WAN interface failover occurs.
globals.stickyInboundHelp: Route inbound reply traffic back through the same interface as the outbound flow.
globals.hookScriptHelp: Optional script run on WAN load-balancing events.

interfaces.title: Interface Health
interfaces.subtitle: Define gateway health checks per WAN interface
interfaces.emptyHint: Add WAN interfaces to monitor their health and enable failover.
interfaces.removeDescription: This will remove all health monitoring configuration for this interface.

rules.title: Load Balancing Rules
rules.subtitle: Traffic matching rules that distribute connections across WAN interfaces
rules.emptyHint: Rules define how traffic is distributed across WAN interfaces.
rules.deleteDescription: This will remove the WAN load balancing rule. This action cannot be undone.

interfaceModal.description: Configure health monitoring for a WAN interface and its gateway.

ruleModal.interfaceRequired: At least one outbound interface is required
ruleModal.description: Define traffic matching criteria and outbound interface selection for WAN load balancing.
